description:
A team inside a `ForgejoOrganization`, with its members. Repositories
grant themselves access to it through `ForgejoRepository.spec.teamRefs`.

deletionPolicy.description: What happens to the Forgejo object when its CR is deleted.

includesAllRepositories.description:
Grant access to every repository of the organization, current and
future.

instanceRef.description:
The `ForgejoInstance` or `ForgejoLocalInstance` this object lives
on. Unset: the cluster's only `ForgejoInstance`, else the only
`ForgejoLocalInstance` of this namespace.

kind.description: The kind of instance a reference designates.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: namespace only applies to kind LocalInstance

memberRefs.description:
Users in the team. The member list is authoritative:
anyone else is removed. A member whose user doesn't exist in Forgejo
yet (e.g. an observed OIDC user who never logged in) is reported as
`MemberPending` while the others are synced.

items.description:
A user, organization or team: a CR (`name`) — of this object's
namespace, or of `namespace` when cross-namespace references are
enabled for the operator and the target lists this namespace in its
`sharedWith` — or an object that exists in Forgejo but no CR manages
(`remoteName`, its Forgejo name). The operator never creates, changes
nor deletes a `remoteName` object.

namespace.description: Namespace of the CR; defaults to this object's own.

remoteName.description:
Forgejo name of an object no CR manages (a user's login, an
organization's or team's name).

x-kubernetes-validations.message: set exactly one of name and remoteName

membersPolicy.description:
Who decides the team's members. `Managed` (the default):
`memberRefs` is authoritative. `External`: the operator never adds
or removes members, leaving them to Forgejo's OIDC group sync
(`group-team-map` / `dyn-group-maps` on the authentication source);
`memberRefs` must then be empty.

name.description: Team name, unique within the organization. `Owners` is reserved.

organizationRef.description:
The organization the team belongs to. A team can't move between
organizations: changing this deletes and recreates it, which needs
the `forgejo.weebo.io/allow-disruptive-update: "true"` annotation.

namespace.description: Namespace of the CR; defaults to this object's own.

remoteName.description:
Forgejo name of an object no CR manages (a user's login, an
organization's or team's name).

x-kubernetes-validations.message: set exactly one of name and remoteName

sharedWith.description:
Other namespaces allowed to reference this object (when the operator
enables cross-namespace references). Unset: this namespace only.

clusterScoped.description: Cluster-scoped objects may use this instance.

namespaceSelector.description:
Namespaces whose labels match this selector may use this instance.
An empty selector (`{}`) matches every namespace: the instance —
and the token it holds — is then shared with the whole cluster.

matchExpressions.description: matchExpressions is a list of label selector requirements. The requirements are ANDed.

items.description: A label selector requirement is a selector that contains values, a key, and an operator that relates the key and values.

key.description: key is the label key that the selector applies to.

operator.description: operator represents a key's relationship to a set of values. Valid operators are In, NotIn, Exists and DoesNotExist.

values.description: values is an array of string values. If the operator is In or NotIn, the values array must be non-empty. If the operator is Exists or DoesNotExist, the values array must be empty. This array is replaced during a strategic merge patch.

matchLabels.description: matchLabels is a map of {key,value} pairs. A single {key,value} in the matchLabels map is equivalent to an element of matchExpressions, whose key field is "key", the operator is "In", and the values array contains only "value". The requirements are ANDed.

namespaces.description: Namespaces whose objects may use this instance.

unitsMap.description:
Per-unit access (`repo.code`, `repo.issues`, `repo.pulls`,
`repo.releases`, `repo.wiki`, `repo.packages`, `repo.actions`, ...)
to `none`, `read`, `write` or `admin`. Empty means every repository
unit at `permission` (Forgejo refuses a team without units). Ignored
by Forgejo when `permission` is `admin`.
